name: liquid-glass-mobile-icons
title: Liquid Glass Mobile Icons
description: A grid of translucent rounded glass tiles holds phone control icons — rotation, notifications, brightness, mute, focus, flashlight, timer, camera and screen record — floating over a photo backdrop.
use: You want a phone-like cluster of quick toggles laid over a photo or wallpaper.
avoid: The icons are decorative with no working toggle state, and the pale icon colour needs a dark backdrop.
a11y: Each icon has a hidden text label, but the draggable tiles cannot be used from the keyboard. (keyboard: no, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A cluster of glassy tiles in two sizes: small round squares for single icons and tall or wide pills for sliders and the Focus toggle. Icons are white outlines on smoky translucent glass with faint inner highlights. They sit over a green leaf beaded with water droplets.
behaves: The arrangement is static and nothing moves on its own. Each glass tile can be dragged on its own and springs back to its spot, and every tile scales up a little on hover and down on press.
customise: The icon set, tile sizes and grid arrangement are written directly in the JSX, so edit the markup to change them. Each tile inherits the glass card's blur, glow and radius defaults.
weight: moderate: Nine blurred glass tiles, each with a displacement filter and drag handlers.
